title: troximon laciniatum
intro: Troximon laciniatum, commonly known as Devil's Bells or Fringed Pincushion, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as wounds, skin irritations, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Troximon laciniatum include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
